credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: Team Office is an open-source project (MIT) made for Carlos.
credits.origin: Concept and technical base: Pixel Agents by Pablo De Lucca (MIT license). Pixel Agents art is not used here.
credits.art: The current art (scenery, furniture and characters) is a placeholder drawn in code for this project, with no third-party images.
credits.fonts: Fonts: Pixelify Sans (interface) and Silkscreen (signs and badges), SIL OFL 1.1 license, bundled locally; the license text ships with the files in assets/fonts.
